remarks: Come home to a quiet street, close to the planned school. This upgraded 1,350 sq ft home is made for everyday family life: an open great room where the island kitchen — granite counters, stainless appliances, a walk-through pantry — keeps everyone together, from weeknight dinners to homework at the counter. Upstairs, the large master bedroom has a full ensuite with tile flooring, bedrooms 2 and 3 are good-sized for growing kids, and a full main bath plus upper-level laundry make the mornings easier. Downstairs, a full open basement is ready for a playroom, a home office, or guests. Outside, a large deck with a privacy screen and a mostly fenced yard give you room to grill, play, and unwind. Oversized single garage for the car — and everything else. Ready for a growing family. (id:67522)
